peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 32.6% above its local comparables; 34 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (95.5): 6.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 42 of 44 similar developments. Initial resale-wave effect: 4 of the 62 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Oct 2024); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2016.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,100,000 ($2,732 psf, 764–882 sq ft; 21 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,092 psf (range $1,822–2,434); 30.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $492,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $4,150,000 ($2,991 psf, 1,011–1,420 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,223 psf (range $1,796–2,483); 34.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $1,066,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 6.7 resales per 100 homes a year over 23 months (Nov 2024–Sep 2026): higher than 42 of 44 similar developments. First resale wave from Nov 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 8 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 6.9.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 470 m, Havelock MRT about 590 m; closer than 12 of 44 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 270 m; more than 29 of 44 similar developments (the same as 12). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 390 m), more than 22 of 44 similar developments (the same as 10); nearest hawker centre Kukoh 21 Food Centre about 620 m; nearest park Jubilee Park (Fcp) about 670 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 170 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 270 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 370 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 410 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 560 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 590 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 590 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 800 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 315 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,451 new sales and 1,056 resales (2,507 purchases); new sales were 57.9% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,410 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,940 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,056 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 33 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,056 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,238 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.7%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
